notes.title: Version 0.799
notes.notes:
* Skill fixes.
* Scenario fixes.
* Quest fixes.
* Increased vendor inventory.
* Difficulty system balancing (evil).
* New translations (*1)

(*1) Note: I added French and Simplified Chinese. I tried my best to make sense of what is shown so that it is as coherent as possible, but there may be errors due to my complete lack of knowledge of these languages.

notes.title: Version 0.798
notes.notes:
* Major fixes to the scenario system
* Fixes to the equipment system
* Inventory improvements, now you can also specify the quantity
* Increased Stash size (*1)
* Network fixes and improvements
* Fixes to the quest system
* Fixes to the Settlement Teleport
* Fixes to enemies and the bot
* New enemies with their abilities
* Fixes to some elements in some scenarios
* Loading bar on the loading screen

(*1) Attention: Due to the increase in the size of the stash, its content will look "deformed", but no items should be lost, it is just an aesthetic fault. You will have to rearrange the items manually to fix it.

notes.title: Important Minor Changes (0.793)
notes.notes:
Getting closer to final release. These changes include:
* Added a few more skills
* Fixed frame syncing
* Other miscellaneous fixes
* Stable networking

notes.title: Version 0.791 with a new level
notes.notes:
A new challenging level so you don't stay wanting more (I'm still wanting more myself, so I think others will be too).
* New hellish level
* Network changes and fixes
* Fixes to some inventory details
* Now the character doesn't stay with a pending click if he's attacking
* Fix to monster AI
* New hellish monsters with new skills for the new level
* Addition of some quests to complete

Although we still need to finish the quests and more character skills, we still have one more level to entertain ourselves. Also, in the next few days some new skills could be ready.

Thanks for your patience.
